posts.en:
graphlint#integrations/dsh is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Dead-code detection for AI-generated codebases: graphlint builds a dependency graph, finds code unreachable from any entry point to enable codebase cleanup and functional‑effectiveness understanding, and exposes graphlint_query / graphlint_build / graphlint_config tools plus a graphlint skill to DSH agents.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-ce96accaabdd3df5ec76.html
